_comment: Catalog of Microsoft Teams admin ConfigAPI types reachable via New-TeamsRequestV2 (https://api.interfaces.records.teams.microsoft.com/Skype.Policy/configurations/{Type}). 'identity' describes the instance model: 'Global' = single tenant-wide object only; 'Named' = Global plus custom named instances (Tag:<Name>). 'premium' flags types whose meaningful settings require a Teams Premium license. ConfigAPI is an undocumented internal surface; treat 'identity' as best-effort and verify per tenant.

types.description: Core meeting policy: lobby, recording, transcription, screen sharing, anonymous join, watermarking and end-to-end encryption toggles.
Tenant-wide meeting settings: anonymous join, meeting join URL / custom branding hooks, QoS port ranges.
Teams Premium meeting branding: custom lobby backgrounds, theming, logos.
Teams Premium: which meeting templates a user may see and use.
Webinars and town halls: who may create them, advanced registration controls (Premium features gated inside).
Teams Premium virtual appointments: SMS notifications, branded waiting room.
End-to-end encryption availability for calls and meetings.
Controls rollout of new recording/transcription behaviour.
Live events policy: who may produce, recording and attendee options.
Tenant-wide live events configuration, including the SDN/eCDN provider.
Chat and channel messaging: edit/delete, read receipts, giphy, urgent messages, chat with external users.
Tenant-wide messaging configuration.
Private and shared channel creation, org-wide teams.
Activity feed and notification behaviour.
File sharing providers available in Teams.
Pinned apps, app bar layout, custom app uploading.
Which Microsoft, third-party and custom apps users may install.

Federation and external access: allowed/blocked domains, Teams Consumer federation, open federation. NOTE: the cmdlet noun is TenantFederationConfiguration; New-TeamsRequestV2 aliases it to this type automatically.
Per-user external access: federated user communication, Teams Consumer, public cloud access.
Azure Communication Services federation.
What guest accounts may do in chat.
Guest meeting capabilities.
Guest calling capabilities.
Calling: private calling, call forwarding, delegation, voicemail, busy-on-busy, spam filtering.
Call park and retrieve.
Custom hold music/branding.
Emergency calling notifications and security desk routing.
Emergency numbers and routing for Direct Routing.
Auto attendant and call queue management permissions.
Shared calling configuration.
Direct Routing voice routes.
Voicemail transcription, profanity masking, maximum recording length.
Normalization rules for dialled numbers.
Dial-in conferencing numbers offered to users.
Third-party compliance recording integration.
Carrier-provided emergency call routing (Operator Connect).
Cloud Video Interop provider for legacy VTC endpoints.
Tenant-wide client behaviour: email integration, resource account calling, organisation tab, third-party cloud storage.
Teams client update ring and preview access.
In-product survey and feedback availability.
Mobile client behaviour over cellular.
Teams-certified desk phone sign-in mode and hot desking.
Bring-your-own-device and hot desk peripherals.
Shifts app behaviour.
Verbose media logging for support diagnostics.
Targeted communications / tag management in teams.
AI feature availability in Teams (Copilot-adjacent controls).
Education assignments app settings.
